faq.q: How far is Puerto Banús from the Ironman finish line?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is approximately 5 km or a 10-minute drive from the Ironman finish line on the Golden Mile. A taxi or ride-share will cost around €10–€15. Many of our charters include a free pickup from your hotel or the finish area if booked in advance.

faq.q: Which boat is best for post-Ironman recovery?
faq.a: For a small group of 5–6, the Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) or Red Tide (11m, 6 pax) offer a relaxed cruise with sunbathing and swimming. For up to 12 pax, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) provides ample deck space, a flybridge with panoramic views, and a shaded saloon for muscle recovery.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?

faq.q: Can we bring our own food and drinks?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks on board. Many of our guests bring post-race recovery snacks, fruit, or a celebratory cake. We also offer catering upgrades (e.g., paella, sushi, BBQ) if ordered at least 48 hours in advance.

faq.q: Is there a minimum charter duration for Ironman groups?

faq.q: Can we swim or use a jet ski during the charter?
faq.a: Absolutely. Swimming stops are always possible at calm spots like Cala del Faro or Cabopino. The Mangusta 80 (Tier B) includes a free jet ski for the duration of the charter. Other boats can arrange jet ski rental upon request (subject to availability and safety briefing).

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for Ironman weekend?
faq.a: We offer free cancellation up to 48 hours before departure. Within 48 hours, a 50% charge applies. For weather-related cancellations, we reschedule or fully refund. We recommend booking early as Ironman weekend is high season and our fleet books out quickly.

data.body_html:
Crossing the finish line of Ironman 2029 in Marbella is a monumental achievement. After months of training, a 3.8 km swim, 180 km bike, and a full marathon, your body and mind deserve more than a hotel pool. A marbella yacht charter ironman 2029 offers the perfect blend of recovery, celebration, and Mediterranean luxury — all within minutes of the finish line on the Golden Mile. Depart from Puerto Banús, sip a cold beer or cava, soak in the sea breeze, and let our licensed skipper handle everything.

Why a Yacht Charter is Ideal for Ironman Recovery

Active recovery after an Ironman is proven to reduce muscle soreness and improve circulation. A gentle cruise along the Marbella coast at 8–12 knots provides low-impact movement, while swimming in the calm, warm Mediterranean (September sea temp ~22°C) aids muscle relaxation. Our charters include unlimited water, isotonic drinks, and light snacks — no heavy meals that upset a post-race stomach. The flybridge of the Azimut 58 or the sundeck of the Mangusta 80 lets you stretch, elevate your legs, and enjoy the view of La Concha mountain without any exertion.

Our Fleet: Choose Your Recovery Vessel

We operate 16 boats from Puerto Banús, all with licensed skippers, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA included. For small groups of 5–6, the Speedboat (7m, €749/2h) or Red Tide (11m, 6 pax) are nimble and affordable. For up to 12 pax, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) offers shaded saloon and flybridge seating. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, from €4,719/4h) includes a free jet ski — perfect for those who want a burst of adrenaline after the race. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, a 10-minute drive from the Ironman finish area.

All prices include Spanish IVA (21%) and no hidden fees. For Ironman groups, we recommend booking a 4-hour afternoon slot (15:00–19:00) to watch the sunset over the Mediterranean.

Recommended Itineraries for Ironman Celebrants

  • Recovery Cruise (2–3 hours): Depart Puerto Banús, cruise east past the Golden Mile, stop for a swim at Cala del Faro, return via Marbella Marina. Ideal for small groups wanting a gentle outing.
  • Sunset Celebration (4 hours): Head west towards Cabopino or Estepona, anchor for a swim and jet ski session (on Mangusta 80), enjoy cava and snacks as the sun sets behind La Concha.
  • Full-Day Indulgence (8 hours): Cruise to Sotogrande or the Strait of Gibraltar, with multiple swimming stops, a paella lunch (catering upgrade), and dolphin watching. Best for groups of 10–12.

All routes are flexible — your skipper will adapt to your energy levels and preferences.

What’s Included — and What’s Not

Every charter includes: licensed skipper, fuel, bottled water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks (chips, olives, nuts, fruit), insurance, safety equipment, and 21% IVA. You are welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks. Jet skis are included free on the Mangusta 80; for other boats, rental can be arranged via WhatsApp. Towels, sunscreen, and swimwear are your own responsibility.

How to Book Your Ironman 2029 Yacht Charter

Booking is simple: visit our Marbella Yacht Charter homepage to browse the full fleet, then send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred boat, date, duration, and group size. We will confirm availability and send a secure payment link. Early booking is strongly recommended — Ironman weekend is peak season and our most popular boats (Azimut 58, Mangusta 80, Astondoa 40) often sell out weeks in advance. We offer free cancellation up to 48 hours before departure.
